body:
Implement a Postgres driver for hive-store to enable multi-node deployments.

Requirements:
- Implement the same Store interface as SQLite driver
- Connection pooling with pg
- Migration system for schema updates
- Support for Postgres FTS (tsvector) for search
- Configuration via environment variables
- Integration tests with testcontainers
